summary: There's a part of you that knows a fast, restless mind and a strong will and deep reserves of energy work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you go after what you want and don't back down. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: There's a part of you that knows a fast, restless mind and a strong will and deep reserves of energy work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you go after what you want and don't back down. It rewards you when you reach for it. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you go after what you want and don't back down.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel, or your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it, then lash out at whoever is closest.
integration: Let thinking and speech and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you go after what you want work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
